items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Benny Heath and I were in that show

ctx.x: Yeah. And Lyle had connections with that show, too. Benny Heath and I were in that show, and it was over in Brooklyn, at the Banks Theatre, I think. Yeah, Banks Street Theatre. But it only lasted one week. And then, of course, we were working odd jobs here and there.

Then we went to Mac Dean's. That was on Jerome Avenue. This was in '35. Now, the show was in late '34, and in '35 we started -- for three seasons we were at Maxine's. And that was a supper club up on Jerome Avenue.
